items.titleZh: 遇见Rania，2025年aramco STEM挑战赛三名获奖者之一
items.summaryZh: Rania是2025年aramco STEM挑战赛的三名获奖者之一，作为她为期一周的沉浸式项目的一部分，她加入了AMR技术校园，亲身体验了F1工程，并了解了赛车运动背后的技术。

media.altZh: 遇见Rania，2025年aramco STEM挑战赛三名获奖者之一 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Meet Rania, one of three winners of the 2025 @aramco STEM Challenge. As part of her week-long Immersion Programme, Rania joined us at the AMR Technolo...
items.summaryEn:
Meet Rania, one of three winners of the 2025 @aramco STEM Challenge.
As part of her week-long Immersion Programme, Rania joined us at the AMR Technology Campus to experience F1 engineering first-hand, working with power unit telemetry and getting a closer look at the technology behind the sport.
detailZh:
遇见Rania，2025年@aramco STEM挑战赛三名获奖者之一。
作为她为期一周的沉浸式项目的一部分，Rania加入了我们，在AMR技术校园亲身体验了F1工程，与动力单元遥测设备一起工作，并更近距离地了解了赛车运动背后的技术。
detailEn:
Meet Rania, one of three winners of the 2025 @aramco STEM Challenge.
As part of her week-long Immersion Programme, Rania joined us at the AMR Technology Campus to experience F1 engineering first-hand, working with power unit telemetry and getting a closer look at the technology behind the sport.

items.summaryZh: 阿斯顿·马丁车队祝贺其技术合作伙伴本田赛车在即将到来的美国大奖赛上达到500场F1赛事的里程碑。

media.altZh: 阿斯顿·马丁车队祝贺技术合作伙伴本田赛车达到500场F1赛事里程碑 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: All at Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team send our congratulations to our Technical Partner @HondaRacingF1, as they reach the milestone of 500 Formu...
items.summaryEn:
All at Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team send our congratulations to our Technical Partner @HondaRacingF1, as they reach the milestone of 500 Formula One races at this weekend's #USGP.
Read more: https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/news/announcement/aston-martin-aramcos-technical-partner-honda-reaches-milestone-of-500-f1-races
detailZh:
所有阿斯顿·马丁阿拉姆科一级方程式车队成员向我们的技术合作伙伴@HondaRacingF1致以祝贺，因为他们在本周末的美国大奖赛（#USGP）达到了500场一级方程式赛事的里程碑。
了解更多：https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/news/announcement/aston-martin-aramcos-technical-partner-honda-reaches-milestone-of-500-f1-races
